name: How much does a waterfall kitchen island typically cost?
description: Costs vary widely based on material, size, and installation complexity; premium materials and extended panels increase the price.

mainEntity.name: How much does a waterfall kitchen island typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a waterfall kitchen island varies significantly based on the material chosen, the island's size, and the complexity of the installation. Premium materials like certain types of marble or custom fabrication will increase the price. When planning your budget, consider that the material cost for the extended side panels adds to the overall expense compared to a standard island. We can provide a detailed estimate after an initial consultation in your Emeryville or Fremont home.
